issues.source_quote: - Хмыренок! Деточка, а вам не кажется, что ваше место возле параши?
issues.translation_quote: Little one, don't you think your proper place is by the slop bucket?
issues.justification: Inconsistent handling of the nickname Хмырь (Creep/Little Creep) and mistranslation of the sarcastic 'деточка' register. Also 'Никола Питерский' rendered as 'Nikola of Piter', an unexplained oddity.

issues.source_quote: Эй, гражданина! Ты туда не ходи, ты сюда ходи, а то снег башка попадет - совсем мертвый будешь!
issues.translation_quote: You no go there, you go here, or snow on head fall - you be totally dead!
issues.justification: Here the pidgin is justified (Vasya's mock-Central-Asian speech), but it is then applied to Vasya in places where he speaks normal Russian (e.g., 'Gas kerosene stove I buy', 'Because it warm there'), making voice inconsistent.

issues.translation_quote: Who's afraid of the big bad wolf
issues.justification: Replaces the Soviet-era Russian version with the Disney song; acceptable but the following rhymed verse is paraphrased, losing 'поросята' wit.

issues.translation_quote: Ain't gonna be no picture show. Electricity's all used up.
issues.justification: Famous catchphrase 'Кина не будет' is rendered in a Western-American register that jars with the Soviet setting.
